items.exampleEn: In the old story, a young prince set out on a quest for a lost treasure.
items.exampleZh: 在那個古老的故事裡，一位年輕的王子出發去尋找失落的寶藏。

items.exampleEn: In most fairy tales, the protagonist is young and brave.
items.exampleZh: 在大多數的童話故事裡，主角都年輕又勇敢。

items.exampleEn: The dancers moved in perfect unison.
items.exampleZh: 舞者們的動作完全一致。

items.exampleEn: The climax of the festival is a huge fireworks show.
items.exampleZh: 這個節慶的高潮是一場盛大的煙火秀。

items.exampleEn: The fiddle is the main instrument in this kind of folk music.
items.exampleZh: 小提琴是這類民謠的主要樂器。

items.exampleEn: As a devotee of old films, he watches one every night.
items.exampleZh: 身為老電影的愛好者，他每晚都看一部。

items.exampleEn: Each flashback in the film is shown in black and white.
items.exampleZh: 電影裡的每段倒敘都以黑白畫面呈現。

items.exampleEn: The orchestra has a large repertory of classical works.
items.exampleZh: 這個管絃樂團有大量的古典曲目可以演出。

items.exampleEn: The screenwriter spent two years working on the script.
items.exampleZh: 那位編劇花了兩年寫這部劇本。

items.sentenceEn: The whole class answered the teacher's question in unison.
items.sentenceZh: 全班齊聲回答了老師的問題。

items.audioEn: Stop fiddling with your phone and listen to me.
items.audioZh: 別再玩你的手機了，聽我說。

items.sentenceEn: The film tells its story through a series of flashbacks.
items.sentenceZh: 這部電影透過一連串的倒敘來講故事。

items.sentenceEn: Readers quickly fall in love with the shy protagonist of this novel.
items.sentenceZh: 讀者很快就愛上這部小說裡那位害羞的主角。

items.stemEn: The music grows louder and louder as the song reaches its ____.
items.stemZh: 歌曲來到高潮時，音樂越來越大聲。

items.stemEn: She is a jazz ____ who has visited every music club in the city.
items.stemZh: 她是個爵士樂迷，城裡每一家音樂俱樂部都去過。

items.passageEn: Our town's small theater company performs a repertory of six plays each year, changing the show every week. This season's most popular play was written by a young local screenwriter. It follows a protagonist who goes on a quest to find her missing brother. The story uses clever flashbacks to show their childhood, and the climax, set on a stormy beach, made many people cry. Critics called the play insightful, and theater devotees travel from other cities just to see it. During the final song, the whole cast sings in unison while an old man plays the fiddle.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上的小劇團每年輪流演出六齣戲，每週換一齣。這一季最受歡迎的戲，是一位年輕的在地編劇寫的。故事描述女主角踏上尋找失蹤兄弟的旅程。劇中巧妙地用倒敘呈現他們的童年，而設在暴風雨海灘上的高潮讓許多人落淚。評論家說這齣戲很有見地，戲劇迷甚至專程從其他城市來看。最後一首歌時，全體演員齊聲合唱，一位老先生則在一旁拉小提琴。

options: 她小時候住過的老房子

questions.questionZh: 這齣戲的高潮發生在哪裡？
options: 山上一座廢棄的老燈塔

items.promptZh: 他是一位得過好幾個獎的電影編劇。
referenceEn: He is a screenwriter who has won several awards.
He is a film screenwriter who has won many prizes.
rubricZh: 「得過獎」可寫，例如 has won awards、has won prizes、award-winning 等

items.instructionZh: 用 quest 造一個句子，說說你正在追尋的一件事。
referenceEn: I am on a quest to find the best coffee in Taipei.
My quest this year is to learn how to swim.
rubricZh: quest 表示「追尋、探索」，用法例如 be on a quest to find…、my quest for… 等
